C0342.title: Shandong Zibo Police Bust Massive Illegal Bulk Registration and Sale of WeChat Accounts
C0342.summary: Zibo police dismantled a criminal gang led by a suspect surnamed Xu. Since 2018, the gang illegally obtained data from Tencent and three major telecom operators, used batch-controlled mobile phones to register WeChat accounts in bulk, and sold them for use in telecom fraud and other criminal activities. Forty-three suspects were escorted back to Zibo.
